About PBL

The Group
For Growth.

As De Anza's chapter of Phi Beta Lambda, we strive to create a constructively critical environment that facilitates exploration, ethical decision-making, and professional development for all De Anza students.

We empower aspiring business leaders through professional development, innovation, and collaboration — offering case competitions, community service projects, professional workshops, and networking events. Open to all majors.

"A place where cohorts convene, careers begin, and professional identity is forged."

Polaris Research Group

Guided bythe North Star.

Where leadership meets specialization — producing rigorous, institutional-quality research.

About Polaris

Polaris Research Group (PRG) is a selective cohort within Phi Beta Lambda designed to cultivate elite undergraduate talent through rigorous, high-impact research and strategic thought leadership.

Inspired by the North Star, Polaris represents our commitment to guiding students into the premier worlds of high finance, strategy, technology, and macroeconomics. Through sector-based research, executive mentorship, and thought-driven publications, PRG is where leadership meets specialization.

Consulting

Real Work.Real Clients.

Student analysts. Real organizations. Portfolio-ready work from day one.

What We Do

PBL's consulting division pairs student analysts with real organizations across industries. Members develop data-driven strategy recommendations under the mentorship of industry professionals — building portfolio-ready work from day one.

Whether market entry analysis, operational improvement, or brand strategy — our teams deliver work that matters.

Market AnalysisBrand StrategyOperationsFinancial ModelingGo-to-MarketData Analysis
01
Intake & Scoping
Client presents their challenge. Our team scopes the project and assembles the right analysts.
02
Research & Analysis
Analysts conduct primary and secondary research, building models under professional mentorship.
03
Delivery & Impact
Teams present strategic recommendations directly to clients — polished, actionable, portfolio-ready.

Community Service Project

Give Back.Lead Forward.

PBL's Community Service Project division — where members serve the community and develop as leaders.

What is CSP

The Community Service Project (CSP) is PBL's dedicated division for community outreach and service. Our members volunteer across the Bay Area — planting trees, packing food, and supporting nonprofits and local organizations that make a difference.

CSP is more than just volunteering. It's where PBL members grow as leaders, build empathy, and demonstrate that business excellence and community care go hand in hand. Every quarter, we organize service events open to all internal members.

Environmental Service Food Security Community Outreach Leadership Development Nonprofit Partnerships Bay Area
